messages.content: You are a calendar assistant. Today is 2026-10-13 in Asia/Shanghai. Use the supplied Calendar tools for actual results; do not invent events.
查询2026年10月13日的日程，按开始时间列出。请调用calendar_events，不要直接编造结果。

function.name: calendar_events
function.description: List the person's calendar events, soonest first: id, title, start, end, location and notes. Times are local, like 2026-10-02T15:00. Filter with from and to (a time or a date); limit caps the list. Entries may include request_id for retry deduplication. These are OctoSense local events, not a Google Calendar account. A returned timezone belongs to that event; from/to filters use device local time unless RFC3339 offsets are supplied. This is the same store displayed by the Calendar app month/day views.

function.name: calendar_get_event
function.description: Exact durable readback by one event id or stable request_id, including authoritative absence. Refuses unreadable or ambiguous records. This is the same built-in Calendar store.

function.name: calendar_add_event
function.description: Add an event to the person's calendar. start (and end) are local times like 2026-10-02T15:00, or a date like 2026-10-02 for the whole day. Answers the new event's id. For retries supply the same stable request_id and exact event fields; it reuses the saved event. Changed fields with that key are refused instead of duplicating it. This is OctoSense local storage, not Google Calendar sync. Supply timezone (IANA, e.g. America/Los_Angeles) to preserve the event wall time independently of device settings. Missing timezone uses device local time. Do not guess an unspecified end.

function.name: calendar_update_event
function.description: Edit one saved Calendar event, keeping its id and original request_id. First use calendar.get_event to read the exact id and pass that event as expected; a stale snapshot is refused. Supply the full replacement title, start, end (omit if unknown), timezone, location and notes. This updates the same Calendar UI record and quietly refreshes its existing event cards. It does not send invites or sync Google Calendar.

function.name: calendar_remove_event
function.description: Remove one saved Calendar event by its exact id. First use calendar.get_event and pass its exact event as expected; a stale snapshot is refused. The Host requires the person's approval. After removal, verify the same id with calendar.get_event: only found:false and event:null establish absence. A card warning does not undo an event deletion.

function.name: calendar_notify
function.description: Show an event on the person's glance screen as an event card, with a notification: name one of the calendar's events by its id (event), or give a title and when (a local time like 2026-10-02T15:00, or words), with a location and notes if any. Calendar draws the card. The same card_id replaces an earlier card. A saved event card opens that exact event in Calendar. An identical live saved-event publication is reused without another notification; edits in Calendar refresh its card.

function.name: calendar_agenda
function.description: Put the person's agenda on the glance screen: a card with the next three events within days (7 by default), with a notification. It replaces the previous agenda card.
